owner_scope: Male and female for Swordsman, Mage and Archer; reusable factory and compatible cutout reuse. Per-action direction count derives from existing RO research plus explicit owner overrides.

research.indexing: ACT groups by actionFamily*8+direction; this is indexed facing count, not proof of eight independently painted source images.
research.owner_override: Four real unmirrored diagonal views for physical sword/bow attacks and all casting actions, including Mage Arcane Bolt/basic attack, CastChannel and CastRelease. Latest owner instruction explicitly includes casting; this is Astraeon policy, not a universal RO claim.

canvas.registration: One shared camera/scale and per-pose source-registered anatomy anchors; never fit alpha bounding boxes.
canvas.overscan_policy: Add 256 source pixels / 128 authoring pixels / 40 runtime pixels per side; preserve pixels-per-meter and world camera position. No pose-wise crop or resizing.

Sit.motion_note: Native Sitting_Enter is chair-height. Explicit 3D floor adaptation lowers pelvis and solves ankles against floor; no 2D warping. Requires final mesh/contact review.

BasicAttack.sampling_authority: Retained earlier BasicAttack illustrations and original native source capture; denser strike sampling, no new poses fabricated.

variant_acceptance.owner_instruction: After the full base set, demonstrate hairstyle and costume replacement on one complete action per class.
variant_acceptance.hidden_surface_policy: Visible same-frame cutouts only. Replacement art must fill its own newly exposed areas; do not claim interchangeable scalp/hair or naked body layers that were never drawn.

Swordsman.policy: Retain earlier BasicAttack and SkillOverhead illustrations. Improve registration/cutout edges in separate reproducible outputs; preserve originals. Use the retained art as visual-quality reference for Mage and Archer.
Swordsman.scope: Male earlier action artwork; not blanket acceptance of all actions, female art, semantic boundaries or gameplay.
Swordsman.current_guide_sampling_compatibility: BasicAttack reconciled to the retained 16 native samples. SkillAction still has a separate 32-pose guide contract and is not blindly imported from the 16-pose historical SkillOverhead.

production_units.BodyCostume: Complete coherent posed clothed body including torso, arms, hands and legs.
production_units.HeadHair: Head and hair from the same frame and camera.
production_units.Weapon: Weapon from the same frame and camera; retain attached hand occlusion separately where needed.

illustration_contract.authoring_method: Rig motion > exact same-camera paintover for each actual frame > same-frame BodyCostume/HeadHair/Weapon cutouts > recomposition. Check both feet and all anatomy before segmentation.
illustration_contract.reuse: Only matching pose, camera and body fit; complete replacement head/costume/weapon follows the same posed master.
